token.label: API Key
token.description: You can obtain API key from [API Settings](https://web.dashworks.ai/admin/api-keys).

generate-answer.label: Generate Answer
generate-answer.description: Generates an answer from a Dashworks bot.

botId.label: Bot ID
botId.description: You can find this by going to Dashworks > Bots, clicking on an existing Bot, and using the 'Copy Bot ID' button on the top right.

message.label: Message
message.description: The message (e.g., a question or prompt) that you want a response to.

inlineSources.label: Inline Sources
inlineSources.description: When true (default), sources will be cited inline in markdown formatting within the answer text.When false, the answer will not contain inline citations.
